summary: Implementation plan to align Project Orion's game-side progression: starting with Weapon Set 1 and unlocking Set 2 + world gear through exploration/combat, unifying Gemstones as the sole currency for Pilot Skills/Feats/Mods with natural Level 6-20 advancement, adding Lv 6+ stone-specific combat bonuses to Gemstone-modified equipment, aligning Belt Slots 3-4 to Level 2, tuning enemy Gemstone drop rates by tier, and gating Satchel debug tools behind Sandbox Bypass.
